cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: One of his more confident picks: Turner is the objectively better striker with height/reach, and Fernandes' boxing is overrated.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: George likes Turner's size as a weight bully at lightweight, points to the good bounce-back finish and green flags from the fight-week interview and new contract.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Turner is a slick kickboxer who will use his range; Fernandez throws wide hooks with a high chin and is only notable for leg kicks.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Nick doesn't trust Turner's fight IQ and notes Fernandes is well-rounded, hard to finish and has never been stopped, so he can weather the early storm.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Angelo thinks Fernandes can wrestle his way to a win and repeat his flow-state performance vs Gam, though he calls it a very close fight.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Doesn't fully trust Turner's comeback after his early retirement, and Fernandes is solid, well-rounded and mixes in takedowns well; likely decision or late TKO, but a lower confidence pick.

options.selection: Jalin Turner by KO/TKO in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Turner is the side whenever he faces a non-wrestler, he's enormous for 155, his fights rarely leave round one, and the odds are close.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Turner should have the cleaner early moments, punish Fernandez's entries with straight shots and knees, and eventually his size and power make the difference.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Medium confidence: Turner is a gifted, huge, hard-hitting lightweight and Fernandes' opposition wouldn't beat him; a naked leg kick could get him cracked early.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects a striking masterclass from Turner, winning by knockout or on points.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Since Turner has never won a decision, Sam says to attack the line and take inside the distance at -105 instead of the -160 moneyline.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Adam doesn't trust Turner when he's the nail rather than the hammer, and Fernandez has four knockdowns in his last three fights with nasty leg kicks and punching power.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Turner's experience against elite lightweights, size and power at 155 outweigh Fernandez's wins over weak opposition; expects a close decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Sam likes the under 1.5 because Turner is a fight finisher whose fights typically end in round one.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Turner has zero decision wins in 15 victories and most of his finishes come in round one; Sam expects him to knock out or submit Fernandes early, saying 'don't get cute with it' at +250.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: He suggests the round 1 prop because it could come as a knockout, a club-and-sub, or a submission off a back take — he expects Turner to get it done early.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He believes Fernandez's chin is exposed and Turner puts him out, calling a second-round finish.

options.selection: Jalin Turner by first round finish

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Suggested as a hedge alongside the Fernandes moneyline since Turner is the bigger, more dangerous finisher.

fights.display: Ian Machado Garry vs Islam Makhache

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: One of his most confident favorites on the card: Makhachev has passed every test, is durable without the weight cut, and Garry's year with Oliveira won't be enough.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Makhachev's wrestling and pressure are too much; Garry won't stop the takedowns and Makhachev's striking is good enough to hold his own.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Garry will have success at range, but over five rounds Makhachev's adaptability and constant grappling threats should take over, and extended top time makes it hard for Garry to recover.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: He concedes Garry likely has the striking advantage (length, movement, sharp counterboxing) and that Islam's inability to lead is a real flaw, but believes the grappling gap is even more significant — Islam's physicality, top pressure and fence wrestling should break the 'Garry lock'. He calls it roughly a 55-45 fight.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Makhachev in the main event.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Angelo says the wrestling is simply too good and Makhachev should take Garry down, though he respects Garry and won't bet it; Jacob agrees Garry's hands won't keep Islam out.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Nick believes Garry is underrated, has the cleaner striking, will be well prepared and the takedowns won't come easily, making the fight much closer than the price indicates.

options.selection: Islam Makhachev by submission in round 4

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: He expects Makhachev to get takedowns and choke Garry out, and is putting money on the submission at +200.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Makhachev has solved every advantage Garry has before (size, reach, boxing), is elite in scrambles with the d'arce and back takes, and Garry can't finish him or out-decision him with Khabib game-planning.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Nobody defends Makhachev's takedowns and Garry lacks one-punch power, so Garry would have to win a decision; Makhachev drags him late for a finish.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: He repeatedly says he thinks the arm triangle happens: once Islam opens the Garry lock and passes to half guard and mount, Garry hasn't shown the ability to scramble up off his back.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Despite giving Garry a 35-40% chance and outlining a game plan for him, he still picks Islam by submission, believing Islam should be able to secure takedowns and control time.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Expects Makhachev to get takedowns, dominate and submit Garry's long neck.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Adam calls it an easy pick he isn't questioning: Garry's takedown defense won't hold up over five rounds, similar to the Shavkat fight, so Makhachev grinds out a decision.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: Garry will be moving and hard to track early, so Islam needs an adjustment period before eventually getting a late finish.

options.selection: Fight does not go the distance

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Jacob wanted Islam inside the distance at +150 but took fight doesn't go the distance at +120 to also cover a weird Garry finish; he expects Islam to wear Garry down and submit him.

options.selection: Islam Makhachev by submission in round 3

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He thinks Garry survives to the third but gets taken down and choked out, so submission in round 3.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Dern's jiu-jitsu is significantly better; Robertson was swept twice and nearly triangled by Amanda Lemos.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Nick calls it a nightmare matchup for Robertson, saying Dern is better everywhere, has the striking and durability edge and could even land takedowns of her own.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: Robertson's control-based game plan won't work on Dern, whose ugly but cleaner striking and BJJ scrambling should win her the later rounds.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Dern is better everywhere - striking, grappling, even wrestling - and is all-time tough; Robertson has no path without takedowns, and capper says he can't see how she wins.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Dern in the co-main event.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Robertson is the better wrestler, should take Dern down and hold top control; Dern isn't a dangerous enough striker to keep her off.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: George thinks Dern's striking improvements are overstated, Robertson is a far more prolific finisher with a better ground-and-pound rate and can put the fight on the floor on her own terms.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Dern's improved striking wins the exchanges while the grappling cancels out; as an experienced champ ahead on the cards she won't risk chasing a finish.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Robertson has a path on the ground, but Adam sees a big standup advantage for Dern and thinks she edges out a decision.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Bad stylistic matchup for Robertson: Dern is dangerous on the ground and clearly more technical and dangerous on the feet, so if Robertson can't dominate with wrestling she loses; borderline confident-picks-list addition possibly in a two-legger.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Even off her back Dern threatens Robertson, and Sam calls +205 a decent number for the submission.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Robertson's steady pressure and composure should let her edge the positional battles and bank control time over five rounds without giving Dern openings.

options.selection: Mackenzie Dern by KO/TKO in round 4

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Dern is better everywhere: good takedown defense, improved striking and elite jiu-jitsu, while Robertson is one-dimensional with abysmal striking, and Robertson is only a +190 dog.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Sam has taken the under expecting Dern to finish, likely by submission.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: Robertson's plan to hold Dern down won't work as Dern's defensive grappling forces scrambles; neither has finishing ability since their grappling cancels out.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: He already bet the Ribovics moneyline around -400; Ribovics is young, insanely tough and high volume while Barboza is old, washed and coming off eye surgery.

cappers.reasoning: Barboza is on a three-fight losing skid and Ribovics's forward pressure and gunslinging boxing will be too much.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Stated as his main card pick to defeat Barboza.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Barboza is a longtime favorite of Adam's but his chin is completely gone; Adam calls it an easy pick for a quick, brutal first-round knockout.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Barboza is 40 and has absorbed massive damage recently; Ribovics is durable, high-volume and pressuring, so he expects a punches-in-bunches breakdown finish.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Barboza's striking will shine at times, but Ribovics' pace and constant forward pressure should swing momentum and create the bigger shots.

cappers.name: Artem MMA

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Ribovics to walk Barboza down, cut off the cage and touch his chin for a relatively easy knockout.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects the win to come most likely by KO.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Barboza can't take a shot at 40 coming off the Turner KO, but Ribovics is a volume guy without much knockout power, so he expects Ribovics to beat him up over a decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Sam has already played the over, valuing Barboza's toughness even though most sharps expect a round-one finish.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: McConico is more technical with height and reach, better from range, and should stop most of Johnson's takedowns while picking him apart.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Attacking a wide line — not because McConico is great, but Johnson looks poor in extended fights at 185 with his small frame.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Jacob says McConico is the better, more technical fighter with better takedown and submission defense, while Dante's striking is sloppy and gas tank questionable; he bet him.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: Coin-flip fight; went with the safe pick as Johnson is scrappier, even though he thinks Johnson is overrated.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Neither man has a clean UFC win, but based on potential, regional wins and power Johnson is the better fighter right now and should have the performance people have been expecting; odds are fine.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Interested in Johnson's finishing potential; his speed and early aggression should find the opening even if McConico has moments in the clinch.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Adam takes Johnson by knockout but says he isn't convinced and wouldn't be shocked if Johnson dropped an ugly decision after his close fight with Brundage.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Johnson's boxing is his real skill set and McConico hates being backed up and hit; the worry is Johnson's terrible fight IQ leading him to wrestle again.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Johnson's explosiveness, power and speed should matter in the striking exchanges and get an early finish, but McConico is the more technical guy and very live as a dog; low to mid confidence.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects McConico to win, most likely by decision, though a late third-round finish is possible.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: McConico has good takedown defense and is strong in early rounds, which is Johnson's only window to win; expects a decision, maybe a split.

cappers.name: Axel MMA

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler

cappers.name: Artem MMA

cappers.name: Axel MMA

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Njokuani can be backed up and outboxed, Alvarez has 22 of 23 wins by finish and big submission upside, so Sam takes ITD at -140 rather than the -250 moneyline.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Magny has seven submission losses and his long limbs make him susceptible to chokes; Brahimaj is younger and a jiu-jitsu specialist.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leans Brahimaj to use forward pressure, pin Magny on the cage and chain takedowns; younger and stronger, though he admits it could be close since Magny is a boogeyman.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Thinks Brahimaj is overrated with wins only over cans, while Magny has huge height/reach, experience and a grappling edge and can pick him apart off the back foot for a decision.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Lists it as a decent price prop to target given he expects an early submission.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Expects Brahimaj to rush the guillotine/front choke early against a fighter who gets into precarious positions in the first round.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Jacob says he will definitely have action on Brahimaj early — first or second round submission — since Brahimaj chases the guillotine relentlessly and Magny is lazy with his head position.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Abdul-Malik is far better on the feet and Stoltzfus's striking is unimpressive; should be an easy win.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA

cappers.reasoning: Says he isn't super confident but Abdul-Malik is younger, more physical, with height, reach and power advantages over a hittable Stoltzfus.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Abdul-Malik to defeat Stoltzfus.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Abdul-Malik to dominate and find an early finish, probably first round.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA

cappers.reasoning: Expects the win most likely by KO.
